evidence.title: Agility Robotics Expands NVIDIA Collaboration as It Prepares Digit 5 for Commercial Scale
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore., Oct 22, 2026 — Agility Robotics , a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced that Digit® 5 will standardize on NVIDIA IGX Thor for its onboard compute, expanding the companies’ collaboration as Agility prepares its next-generation humanoid robot for broader commercial deployment. The new architecture will unify Digit 5’s onboard compute by standardizing on NVIDIA IGX Thor modules. The transition establishes NVIDIA as the exclusive provider of onboard compute for the general availability version of Digit 5. “Bringing humanoid robots to commercial scale requires AI computing and safety to be engineered together,” said Deepu Talla, Vice President of Robotics and Edge AI at NVIDIA. “By standardizing Digit 5’s onboard compute on NVIDIA IGX Thor and incorporating NVIDIA Halos into its safety system, Agility is bringing these capabilities together as it prepares for broader deployment in factories and warehouses.” Advancing Compute and Safety for Industrial Deployment The compute transition builds on Agility’s previously announced collaboration with NVIDIA Halos safety platform for physical AI deployments, addressing safety at each layer of Agility’s
